content: Lead the development of all frontend applications across mobile and web, owning architecture, implementation, and long-term maintainability.
Designed and implemented scalable frontend architectures using {{BLoC}}, {{Riverpod}}, {{Clean Architecture}}, and {{MVVM}} patterns.
Owned frontend infrastructure and {{cloud hosting}} setup, ensuring stable deployments and reliable production environments.
Collaborated closely with designers and product managers to deliver features end-to-end in a fast-paced startup environment.
Mentored junior developers through code reviews and technical guidance, improving code quality and delivery consistency.
